name: Cap of Water Breathing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Bubble of Air
powers.text: Underwater, a bubble of air forms around your head so you breathe normally.

summary: Underwater, a bubble of air forms around your head so you can breathe.
text: While wearing this cap underwater, you can take a Magic action to create a bubble of air around your head. It allows you to breathe normally underwater. This bubble stays with you until you take the action again, the cap is removed, or you are no longer underwater.
